name: Trader direct acceptance, exact native offer and daily or concurrent limit

steps._note: Run against a prepared single-player and dedicated Purge trader with one eligible normal job. Enter dialog through native trader interaction. Capture offer and journal before selection.

Select one current normal job through the real card. Capture accepted QuestCode and the removed offer. Repeat with final concurrent slot, daily cap, older unstamped active journal and a stale list response. A failed or stale offer must remain or refresh without adding a duplicate quest.

For the exact native journal gate, compare a freshly added quest with a different offer that shares an active code and a repeat of the accepted instance after day rollover. Only the first actual admission may stamp the acceptance day or consume the corresponding offer. Verify special and authenticated dedicated offers separately.
